gloss: difficult spot; dangerous place; treacherous point

definitions.gloss: difficult spot; dangerous place; treacherous point
definitions.explanation: A place that is difficult or dangerous to pass through, such as a steep mountain path, a treacherous stretch of road, or a hazardous section of a river. Also used figuratively for the hardest part of a task or challenge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難所|なんしょ}だ。
examples.english: This mountain pass is the most treacherous part of the climb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難所|なんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ようやく⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: We finally got past the most difficult point of the construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{難所|なんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}ま→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: At treacherous points where steep cliffs continue, you must proceed carefully using a rope.

notes:
USAGE:
{難所|なんしょ} is used both literally for physically dangerous or hard-to-navigate places and figuratively for the toughest part of a project or undertaking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難所|なんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧ (to overcome a difficult point)
- {難所|なんしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}しかかる (to come to a difficult stretch)
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難所|なんしょ} (the greatest difficulty/most treacherous point)
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難所|なんしょ} (a difficult stretch of road)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難所|なんしょ}: difficult/dangerous spot (specific location)
- ⟦{難関|なんかん}→難関：16164_nankan⟧: difficult barrier, tough challenge (more abstract)
- ⟦{難点|なんてん}→難点：15828_nanten⟧: weak point, drawback (flaw or shortcoming)
